WRITTEN COMPLAINT

Complainant: Neha Patil
Police Station: Shivaji Nagar Police Station
Date: 14 August 2026
Occurrence: 14 August 2026 at approximately 20:35
Location: Senapati Road junction, Pune
Vehicle: MH-12-AB-4821
Person complained against: Rohan Mehta
Victim: Amit Kulkarni
Statement: I was present near the junction and saw the vehicle approach the crossing. After the collision, I called for assistance and remained at the scene until police personnel arrived.
